faces.name: Pyrohemia
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of the end step, if no creatures are on the battlefield, sacrifice this enchantment.
{R}: This enchantment deals 1 damage to each creature and each player.

faces.name: Pyrokinesis
faces.oracleText:
You may exile a red card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Pyrokinesis deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures.

faces.name: Pyromancer Ascension
faces.oracleText:
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that has the same name as a card in your graveyard, you may put a quest counter on this enchantment.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell while this enchantment has two or more quest counters on it, you may copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.

faces.name: Pyromancer's Assault
faces.oracleText: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, this enchantment deals 2 damage to any target.

faces.name: Pyromancer's Gauntlet
faces.oracleText: If a red instant or sorcery spell you control or a red planeswalker you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 2 to that permanent or player instead.

faces.name: Pyromancer's Goggles
faces.oracleText: {T}: Add {R}. When that mana is spent to cast a red instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.

faces.name: Pyromancer's Swath
faces.oracleText:
If an instant or sorcery source you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 2 to that permanent or player instead.
At the beginning of each end step, discard your hand.

faces.name: Pyromancy
faces.oracleText: {3}, Discard a card at random: This enchantment deals damage to any target equal to the mana value of the discarded card.
